 Ready to do your best work? Join us.
 About The Role
 Kognitiv is hiring a Cybersecurity SOC Analyst to investigate security alerts, improve detection rules and monitor how sensitive data moves across our environment. You'll support Kognitiv globally, adding European time-zone coverage alongside our North American security coverage.
This is a hands-on security operations role. Your focus will be working with our security information and event management (SIEM) platform and data loss prevention (DLP) tools, rather than leading audits, managing identity and access, or owning security strategy. You'll report to Ousmane Ndiaye and work closely with him on day-to-day security operations.
What You'll Do
Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts in Rapid7 InsightIDR, bringing together logs from firewalls, endpoints and other devices, and help mitigate verified security incidents.
Write and tune detection rules that correlate events across sources, including endpoint detection and response signals from SentinelOne. Identify opportunities to automate triage and reduce manual effort.
Review DLP events in Cyberhaven to identify potentially inappropriate movement of client or company data, including transfers to personal email or AI platforms.
Follow up with colleagues and their managers to understand flagged activity and investigate potential security concerns.
Apply your understanding of the technology being protected to distinguish suspicious behavior from expected activity.
Track emerging threats, malware and cloud vulnerabilities, and contribute findings to incident response playbooks and detection improvements.
What You'll Bring
Hands-on SOC analyst experience investigating alerts and working with SIEM platforms. We're targeting experience typically gained over 2-4 years; this is not an entry-level role or an upper limit on experience.
Practical experience with Rapid7, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM. You should be able to explain how you've used the platform in real investigations; prior Rapid7 experience is not required.
Experience working with DLP tools and investigating potential data loss or inappropriate data transfers.
Querying, scripting or programming skills you can apply to security analysis and detection rules. Experience with LEQL, KQL, SPL or Python is relevant; you don't need to know all of them.
A broad understanding of IT systems, network protocols and cloud architectures, gained through a relevant technical degree or equivalent industry experience.
Practical experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools alongside your SIEM and DLP work.
A methodical approach to active investigations and careful attention to log data, network traffic and subtle indicators of compromise.
Curiosity and a willingness to keep learning as threats, vulnerabilities and attacker tactics evolve.
Nice to Have
Experience with Rapid7, Cyberhaven or SentinelOne.
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK or CIS Controls to support your analysis.
Security+, CySA+, a relevant Splunk security certification or Rapid7 InsightIDR Certified Specialist. Certifications are helpful, not mandatory.
SIEM engineering or log-platform configuration experience.
Location and Working Hours
This role is intended to be based in Europe and supports Kognitiv globally. You'll generally work regular hours in your local time zone, with occasional later meetings to collaborate across regions. Visa sponsorship is not available.
